TerritoryClaim.title: TerritoryClaim
TerritoryClaim.description: A legally staked mineral territory claim with coordinates, owner info, and yield stats

ownerName.description: Display name of claim deed holder

stakedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when claim was legally driven

extractedGold.description: Accumulated ounces of gold extracted from this claim

blocksDug.description: Total excavated ground blocks within claim boundary

isWildcatOrigin.description: Whether this claim was established after a wildcatting operation

forSale.description: Whether claim is listed on public territorial claims board

priceDollars.description: Asking cash price in 1880s US dollars

priceGoldOunces.description: Asking price in raw placer gold ounces

description.description: Prospector survey notes and description of the mineral patent

listedAt.description: Timestamp when claim was posted for trade or sale

lastTransferPrice.description: Last recorded sale price in dollars

ClaimInfringement.title: ClaimInfringement
ClaimInfringement.description: Real-time dispatch when an unauthorized prospector or wildcatter digs or builds on another player's claimed territory

claimName.description: Name of deeded claim being trespassed upon

jumperId.description: Prospector ID of the wildcatter / claim jumper

jumperName.description: Display name of the wildcatter / claim jumper

resolved.description: Whether this infringement dispute has been settled or contested

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Pardner and fellowship alliance between two prospectors in the Superstition Wilderness

senderId.description: Prospector ID who sent the pardner request

senderName.description: Display name of the sender prospector

receiverId.description: Target prospector ID or callsign receiving the pardner pact

receiverName.description: Display name of the receiver prospector

status.description: Current status of the pardner alliance

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp when pardnership was formed

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of last status change

ClaimTradeOffer.title: ClaimTradeOffer
ClaimTradeOffer.description: Commercial barter or cash tender offered for a territory claim patent

targetOwnerId.description: Current owner prospector ID receiving the offer

offeredClaimId.description: Optional barter claim patent offered in exchange
